description: SPF, DKIM and DMARC check, email deliverability and email security grade. Grade a domain's email security A to F: SPF record and its policy, DMARC record and policy, DKIM keys at 26 common selectors, MX records and MTA-STS, with a plain list of issues to fix. Tells you whether mail from the domain is easy to spoof. Price: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
